ColumnRequireAcceptanceCriteria: Require at least one acceptance criterion on entry
ColumnRequireAcceptanceCriteriaHelp: Tickets must have at least one acceptance criterion to enter this column, including on creation. Existing tickets are unaffected.
ColumnAcceptanceCriteriaRequiredError: This column requires at least one acceptance criterion. Add one in the ticket before moving it here.
ColumnRequireValidatedAcceptanceCriteria: Require all acceptance criteria to be validated on entry
Requires at least one acceptance criterion and a PASS status for every criterion. Pending, ready to evaluate and needs rework criteria block entry. Existing tickets are unaffected.
ColumnAcceptanceCriteriaNotValidatedErro: This column requires every acceptance criterion to be validated (PASS). Add at least one criterion and validate them all before moving the ticket here.
